bibl.title: "A Lydian pipe and the Lydian tunes of the lyre serve me": the Anonymous Aulodia (POxy XV, 1795) and the Genre of Aulody.
bibl.seg: Sylvain Perrot, "A Lydian pipe and the Lydian tunes of the lyre serve me": the Anonymous Aulodia (POxy XV, 1795) and the Genre of Aulody.

Luigi Bravi, Liana Lomiento, Angelo Meriani & Giovanna Pace (edd.), Tra lyra e aulos: tradizioni musicali e generi poetici = Quaderni della "Rivista di cultura classica e medioevale". 14 (Pisa - Roma, 2016) pp. 246-266.
bibl.note: Investigates the lambda strophe of an alphabetic poem, preserved by P. Oxy. XV, 1795 (= MP3 1617; LDAB 4490), in order to ask the genre that the poem belonged to.
